mechanism: Establish a protector-dependent relationship before movement, show the protector choose and lead one continuous route while maintaining readable contact, preserve both identities through the environment, then cross one visually distinct threshold together and hold their connection.

invariants.rule: Establish the protector and dependent role through visible contact before travel.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting in motion obscures the relationship.

invariants.rule: Show the protector choose or confirm one route before escorting.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained cut to travel removes agency.

invariants.rule: Maintain readable physical or spatial guidance through the route.
Keep both identities and recurring landmarks traceable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing one subject breaks the route.

invariants.rule: Cross one distinct threshold together and hold connection.
invariants.ablation_failure: Separate crossings or a premature cut leave the outcome unclear.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source embrace and escort choreography
